crossRefs.note: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons…

people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Noah, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
